build_ViPNAS_MobileNetV3_backbone: build a ViPNAS_MobileNetV3 backbone with custom width, depth, and kernel size configs for video pose estimation
create_InvertedResidual_layers: create InvertedResidual layers with SE attention and configurable expansion ratio for the backbone
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the ViPNAS_MobileNetV3 backbone to extract feature maps from input tensor
freeze_backbone_stages: freeze selected stages of the ViPNAS_MobileNetV3 backbone to prevent gradient updates during training
configure_norm_eval_mode: configure BatchNorm layers to stay in eval mode during training to freeze running statistics
